status: 0.79.13 OPEN: T2 display instance and core/window channel ownership integrated; no task or acceptance closed
scope: Explicit internal Device/GSP runtime API. Bound display instance plus empty physical core/window command rings. No automatic activation, mode adoption or display method producer; passive bootfb remains default.

facts.root: C670 root, C67D core and C67E window classes discovered from RM. Firmware-internal client/subdevice owns WRITE_INST_MEM and pushbuffer controls; channel RM objects belong to the display root. Window index must be present in the actual hardware mask.
facts.instance: Exactly 64KB aligned contiguous initially cleared private VRAM, retained through the existing native storage Use. WRITE_INST_MEM uses physical FB address/cache2. Producer close does not drop the device hold; uncertain or rejected control retains it. Root/channel Free cannot release this Device-lifetime hardware pointer. Reset or a later proven physical handoff is required.
facts.pushbuffer: One private 4096-byte coherent SYS BO per channel, zeroed with CPU-unmap visibility before DMA acquisition. Exact 40-bit physical segment, cache snooping and PHYS_PCI_COHERENT. This is physical display DMA, not the C56F virtual GPFIFO. No display method or PUT write yet.
facts.ownership: Stable embedded owners, namespace children, epoch/root/config/BO stamps and exact Exchange ownership. Device admission compares canonical request bytes, owner, pointer, function and fixed deadline. Returned pControl is opaque remote RM output and never a CPU pointer or MMIO permission.
facts.teardown: Windows retire before core because RM core destruction may purge satellites. After allocation could have reached hardware, neither rejection nor Free ACK authorizes BO release alone. Exact typed Device MMIO admission follows queued-event processing; two equal control/status samples bracketed by live identity checks must prove DEALLOC, disconnected, PUT writes disabled, idle stages, empty FIFO, no pending reads/writes and no executing method.
facts.errors: Missing resources and confirmed pre-allocation rejection unwind without GPU reachability. Ambiguous descriptors, unmap/release failure, uncertain ACK, stale identity, bad replies, queued faults or elapsed deadline quarantine while retaining reachable buffers, names, instance and boot/firmware graph. A host model proves software decisions only.
facts.diagnostics: Root reports bound instance; channels report class/index/physical ring and raw last control/status, possible allocation and confirmed RM ownership. The display-channel operation is included in the existing fault journal.

validation.reference: 18 pinned complete originals. Independent C compilation checks 24/56/40-byte instance/pushbuffer/allocation parameters; seven request/reply pairs total 768 bytes and 134 GA102 original-macro register cases. Existing root vectors remain covered.
validation.device: 13 added scenarios inside the existing actual Device group: core/window lifetime, instance rejection/ACK failure, OOM, malformed segment, CPU unmap failure, pushbuffer/allocation rejection, channel ACK failure, failed Free, busy timeout, DMA release failure and queued fault. Includes copied owner/request/config/deadline rejection, HPD interleaving, producer-close retention and blocked premature parent destruction.

results.vector.log: instance/core/window pairs=768 bytes; GA102 retirement=134 original-macro cases

validation.guest: No repeated QEMU run: Kernel, SDK, Contract and common display/queue APIs unchanged.
validation.limits: No physical GPU qualification, scanout/mode adoption, RAMHT population, display method execution, or permission to replace the boot display in the product path.
